items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Terminology 92:1
items.html: (To the question) What are the gentle in the head and the strong in the end? This discernment of the gentle in the head and the strong in the end exists both in ZA and in the Nukva, but from particular aspects. And they are also discerned in the opposite discernment — of the strong in the head and the gentle in the end — and this too is both in ZA and in the Nukva. And it is because there are in ZA two kinds of Mochin: one is his own Mochin, which are from the male Gevurot, drawn from the first restriction. And he also has the Mochin for the sake of the Nukva, which clothe in his NHY, which become Mochin for the Nukva. And in his own Mochin, it is found that the Dinim of ZA are gentle in the head, for there is there a coupling upon his crown of Gevura, and it is sweetened. But in the end, namely in his NHY, they are strong, for there is no coupling there, because all the NHY are the ten Sefirot of conclusion, where is the strength of the Dinim that conclude toward the Partzuf. And from the aspect of the Mochin of the Nukva that are in him, in order to bestow to his Nukva, there is the opposite discernment, for they are strong in the head, because in the place of the exit of the Mochin of the Nukva in the head of ZA, the Malchut of Ima is found joined with the crown of Gevura of ZA, in order to bring out the stature of the Mochin of the Nukva. And therefore the aspects of the Dinim of the first restriction in the crown of Gevura also rule there, in the Mochin of the Nukva, and they are strong, as is known that the Malchut of the first restriction is the quality of judgment, in which the world cannot endure without the association of the quality of mercy, which is the second restriction. But in the end, namely in the NHY of ZA, which come in clothing in the Mochin of the Nukva, there is found there only the aspect of the Malchut of Ima, which is from the second restriction, and the aspect of the root of the Dinim, which is the crown of Gevura of ZA, remains in ZA himself, as is known. Thus there they are gentle in the end, namely in the NHY that became Mochin for the Nukva, which is the clothing of the sun in its sheath, for there is already nothing there but the aspect of the weak judgment alone, which is the aspect of the Malchut of the second restriction, which is the quality of mercy, as is known. Thus, from the aspect of his own Mochin, it is discerned as the gentle in the head and the strong in the end; and from the aspect of the Mochin of the Nukva found in him, it is discerned as the strong in the head and the gentle in the end.
